title: Global MMLU: Understanding and Addressing Cultural and Linguistic Biases in Multilingual Evaluation
reasoning: The paper specifically analyzes the 'World Religions' and 'Moral Scenarios' subjects within the MMLU benchmark to identify cultural and linguistic biases. It evaluates these categories for cultural sensitivity, provides inter-annotator agreement metrics for them, and includes them in its large-scale model performance evaluations across 42 languages.
